card.name: Partway through drug names, and linking words
card.fires_on: Responds mid-way through long drug or enzyme names (e.g. dutasteride, lurasidone, monoamine, liposome injectable). Also fires on small linking words like for, to, from after words such as responsible or essential in descriptions of body processes.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: A middle piece of a longer drug or chemical name, before the name is finished.
modes.example: any confirmed increase in PSA while on dut<<aster>>ide may signal the presence of prostate cancer

modes.label: Linking word after responsible/essential
modes.description: A short linking word that follows an adjective about enzyme or blood function and introduces the process.
modes.example: MAO, which is responsible<< for>> the catabolism of tyram
